steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, input the number of columns to pool (choose any integer from 1 to 12) and generate the protocol file for the Sample‑Barcoding Module.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol into OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as follows: Slot 1 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack; Slot 2 – empty; Slot 3 – Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL) containing the samples from Part 3; Slot 4 – empty; Slot 5 – empty; Slot 6 – Opentrons 24‑tube rack loaded with 2 mL DNA LoBind tubes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate the tip rack, the 96‑well plate, the tube rack, and the Opentrons P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 pipette with calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run the pooling protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App; the robot will use the P300 Single‑Channel pipette with 200 µL filter tips to pool each column of the destination plate into its corresponding 2 mL LoBind tube (up to 12 columns, one tube per column).
